categories.name: Detection & Screening of Weapons, Contraband, Explosives and Radioactive Materials
Biometric Systems & Software, Audio and Image Forensics
Support Tools for Target Protection & Crime Suppression

products.name: Handheld Raman Spectroscopy Drug & Explosives Detector
products.desc: A handheld Raman spectroscopy device designed for the rapid identification of powder and liquid substances such as explosives, narcotics, controlled substances, hazardous chemicals and dangerous chemical warfare agents. With fluorescence-noise rejection and a fully automated analysis process, the device enables effective, non-destructive testing of the sample.

products.name: Vapor-Phase Explosives, Narcotics & Hazardous Chemical Detector
products.desc: A device designed to rapidly detect trace vapors of explosives, narcotics, hazardous chemicals and chemical warfare agents in the air, on skin or on clothing, using modern Ion Mobility Spectrometry (IMS) technology. Fast detection time combined with accurate substance identification against a built-in reference library increases screening effectiveness in emergency situations at security checkpoints, customs and border crossings.

products.name: Rapid Chemical & Radiation Detector
products.desc: A handheld, two-in-one device enabling rapid detection of both toxic chemicals and radioactive materials, suited to mobile police, special forces and military units. The device can quickly detect dangerous toxic agents such as organophosphorus compounds (GD, GB, VX) and arsenic compounds. When a reading exceeds the threshold, the device issues an audible alert and a visual indication on its LED display. Fast detection speeds up response in emergency situations.

products.name: Handheld X-ray Screening Device
products.desc: A handheld X-ray screening system fitted with a compact X-ray source and detector panel, enabling mobile inspection to detect weapons and prohibited items concealed in luggage, bags, packages, parcels or inside vehicles. The device allows non-destructive inspection, and is especially effective at hard-to-reach locations such as tires, wall cavities, vehicle doors and other confined spaces. With a flexible design and sharp imaging capability, the system helps authorities quickly and safely verify suspicious objects.

products.name: Handheld Backscatter X-ray Screening Device
products.desc: Used to clearly and accurately detect threats such as weapons, contraband and explosives. Using backscatter X-ray technology in a compact, portable design, the device is especially useful for inspecting hard-to-reach locations that conventional screening equipment cannot reach. Radiation output is at a safe level, with no impact on the operator or the environment, making it suitable for frequent use in security inspection and monitoring.

products.name: Next-Generation X-ray Baggage Scanner
products.desc: An X-ray baggage scanner deployed at security checkpoints such as airports and stations to detect weapons, explosives, narcotics and other dangerous items concealed in luggage, parcels or mail. The device integrates modern AI technology to automatically recognize threats such as firearms, firearm parts and knives, improving accuracy and reducing inspection time. The scanner helps raise the effectiveness of security screening, reduce human error and support fast, timely incident response.

products.name: Mobile X-ray Vehicle Screening System
products.desc: A vehicle-mounted X-ray screening system is a mobile security inspection solution that can be deployed rapidly, and is especially effective in areas with limited infrastructure or where flexibility is required. The system enables fast detection, inspection and handling of potential threats such as weapons, explosives or other dangerous items, while ensuring safety, security and confidentiality during operation.

products.name: Liquid Explosives Detector
products.desc: A device dedicated to police, military and airport security forces for inspecting liquids to detect explosive components or hazardous, flammable chemicals concealed in common containers such as ceramic, glass, plastic or sealed metal bottles and jars.

products.name: Handheld Flammable & Explosive Liquid Detector
products.desc: A handheld device using electromagnetic tomography technology to quickly and accurately detect flammable or explosive liquids inside sealed containers without opening them. The system offers high reliability, capable of identifying a wide range of hazardous substances such as gas, acetone, nitroglycerin, various alcohols, ethers and other volatile compounds. The ergonomic design makes it convenient to operate, suited to security screening and fire-prevention tasks.

products.name: Walk-Through Explosives & Weapons Detection Gate
products.desc: A threat-detection system that uses centimeter-wave technology combined with a magnetometer to automatically detect, in real time, explosives, weapons, flares, narcotics and currency concealed on a person, in a backpack or in carry-on luggage. The system can scan multiple targets simultaneously with high accuracy over a wide detection zone, and supports audible, visual and on-screen marking of the suspect location.

products.name: Mobile Under-Vehicle Inspection System
products.desc: A mobile system for vehicle inspection, designed to quickly detect dangerous items such as weapons, explosives, narcotics and contraband hidden under a vehicle without slowing traffic flow at the checkpoint. Produces high-resolution imagery, can scan the entire underside of a vehicle, is shielded against interference from sunlight, and includes automatic foreign-object detection.

products.name: Next-Generation Voice/Audio Forensics System
products.desc: A solution comprising dedicated hardware and software that performs audio processing and voice-biometric comparison and analysis accurately and efficiently. The system is widely used by law enforcement agencies, government organizations and private forensic experts worldwide for identification, identity verification and criminal investigation support through audio data.

products.name: Multimodal Audio & Image Data Processing System
products.desc: A system developed to collect, build and manage a biometric database based on voice and facial data, supporting large-scale search, comparison and analysis. When ingesting a large volume of audio files containing one or more speakers, the system identifies and matches each voice against samples stored in the database to determine potential matches. For image data, the system supports facial recognition and comparison against existing records, even when a single file contains multiple faces. The system also includes advanced analytics to detect and clarify relationships between subjects within the input audio dataset.

products.name: Facial Recognition System
products.desc: An AI-powered security surveillance solution enabling real-time face detection and recognition, access control and vehicle classification. The system can process low-quality video data with high recognition accuracy, while supporting simultaneous management of multiple cameras and subject-journey tracking. Its architecture is open and flexible, integrating easily with urban CCTV networks, monitoring/command centers and existing security systems.

products.name: Voice Stress & Emotion Analysis System
products.desc: A voice stress and emotion analysis system that effectively supports security investigators in detecting hidden emotions associated with deceptive behavior. By decoding emotional signals in speech, the system helps investigators and monitoring personnel better understand a subject's motives, psychological state and level of honesty, improving the accuracy and effectiveness of assessment, interrogation and decision-making.

products.name: Digital Forensics Analysis Software
products.desc: Analyzes electronic data from a suspect's device (calendar, contacts, calls, WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook messages, etc.) to build a network of associates for expanded investigation; includes recovery of deleted messages and analysis of social-media activity to uncover links between the suspect and related parties, helping to reveal relationships or hidden information in cyberspace.

products.name: Voice Stress & Emotion Analysis System for Interrogation Support
products.desc: The system can detect the emotions underlying a deceptive statement, helping investigators and monitoring staff understand the motive behind what is said. The technology identifies various levels of stress, cognitive load and emotional response reflected in different characteristics of speech, providing detailed insight into how the speaker is thinking, what concerns or excites them, which parts of their statement they are uncertain about, and which areas appear to be sensitive topics for the speaker.

products.name: Specialized Fingerprint Analysis & Reproduction System
products.desc: A device used to capture, process, enhance and reconstruct fingerprints from electronic data sources or fingerprint samples collected during an investigation. The system supports analysis of fingerprint identification features, sample-quality assessment, and high-precision physical fingerprint reproduction for forensic examination, digital investigation, security, defense and biometric research. The solution comes in two deployment versions: a field-operations version (compact design, easy to transport, rapid on-site deployment for investigation, tracing, subject identification and field operations) and a fixed laboratory version (optimized for laboratory environments, supporting continuous, high-volume operation for forensic examination, research, training and biometric system evaluation). The system provides an end-to-end workflow from data capture and image processing to feature analysis, reconstruction and fingerprint simulation.

products.name: Digital Data Extraction & Analysis System
products.desc: A system used to collect, extract, back up, recover and analyze electronic data from a wide range of sources, including HDD/SSD drives, Flash storage devices, USB drives, memory cards, DVR/NVR/CCTV recording systems, in-vehicle electronic devices and other digital devices. The system supports both physical- and logical-level data access, creates forensic copies, and recovers data that has been deleted, partially overwritten, or damaged due to hardware failure, firmware faults, file-system errors and other causes. Using dedicated tools, the system can analyze data structure, activity history, user data, location data, system logs, multimedia data and related electronic evidence, supporting investigation, digital forensic examination, high-tech crime prevention, digital data analysis, and helping to clarify relationships, behaviors, events or digital traces relevant to a case.

products.name: Wiretap Detection System for Telephone Lines, Network Cables & Power Lines
products.desc: Used to measure and analyze various types of lines such as telephone lines, alarm and fire-alarm lines to detect eavesdropping devices and other threats. The device combines multiple line-testing methods — voltage, current, impedance, capacitance — together with newer technologies to ensure maximum detection effectiveness.

products.name: RF Bug & Wireless Eavesdropping Detector
products.desc: A handheld spectrum analyzer that is an ideal tool for law enforcement agencies conducting communications-network surveys, analyzing and locating radio-frequency emission sources, and assessing use of communication channels. The device also plays an important role in investigating spectrum-abuse activity and detecting unauthorized wireless transmit/receive devices. With a compact, portable design, the device is suited to field use and helps improve surveillance effectiveness, information security and safe communications.

products.name: Hidden Camera Lens Detector
products.desc: A compact, handheld device specifically designed to detect hidden surveillance cameras, operating on the principle of light reflection from an optical camera lens. With multiple flexible operating modes and an ergonomic design, the device is convenient to use. Users can also pair it with a smartphone to photograph or video the scene, supporting reporting and record-keeping.

products.name: Non-Linear Junction Detector
products.desc: A device designed to search for, detect and locate concealed electronic devices and unauthorized eavesdropping equipment in areas requiring high security, even when the target device is powered off. The device can detect both small, modern circuits built with surface-mount components and older-generation circuits hidden within high-density materials. Alerts are given as both an audible tone and a visual signal, helping the user easily and effectively identify and pinpoint a suspect location.

products.name: 24/7 Smart Eavesdropping Detection System
products.desc: A system designed to provide continuous, remote radio-frequency monitoring of an area requiring security protection, with the primary goal of detecting abnormal signals and accurately locating their source in order to prevent eavesdropping and unauthorized dissemination of information.

products.name: Sniper Detection System
products.desc: A system designed for automated, remote surveillance across both the visible and infrared spectral bands, effectively supporting law enforcement forces in border protection, coastal surveillance, sniper-position detection, counter-terrorism, counter-espionage and protection of critical areas. The device can detect optical and opto-electronic devices, as well as measure target range with high accuracy. With advanced technology integration and the ability to operate without direct contact with the target, the system provides a comprehensive, proactive and effective surveillance solution for complex security situations.

products.name: Day/Night Observation & Recording System
products.desc: A handheld device specifically designed to help law enforcement forces maintain continuous day-and-night video surveillance, regardless of harsh weather conditions such as fog, rain or snow. The device can detect opposing optical devices being used for observation or aiming, improving proactive counter-surveillance and anti-ambush capability. It also allows observation through tinted or reflective glass on buildings or vehicles, extending the surveillance range in shielded areas. A rangefinder feature helps accurately determine the position and distance of the observed subject, supporting situational assessment and tactical decision-making.

products.name: Narrow-Gap Inspection Scope System
products.desc: A dedicated equipment set for security forces, enabling covert inspection and visual observation of hard-to-reach areas through narrow door gaps, small holes and similar openings. The device can capture high-quality photos and video for evidentiary purposes. It integrates a screen for viewing and direct control of the viewing direction, and operates mobile and independently using a rechargeable battery.

products.name: Digital Voice Recorder
products.desc: A device designed to record high-quality mono audio from a distance, even in complex acoustic environments. Compact, lightweight and housed in a durable metal casing, the device is suited to covert recording tasks. Users can start recording via a switch, voice activation, or a scheduled timer. Recorded data is encrypted and can only be accessed through dedicated companion software.

products.name: Directional Audio Recorder
products.desc: A dedicated recording device designed to operate effectively in noisy environments. Using a microphone array combined with advanced signal-processing algorithms, the device enhances the clarity of speech arriving from a specified direction while suppressing most ambient noise. An integrated camera lets the user easily identify and focus on the direction of interest. The device includes companion speech-processing software supporting both live and post-processing, and can also be remote-controlled via Wi-Fi using a smartphone as a convenient control tool.

products.name: Laser Acoustic Microphone
products.desc: A long-range audio pickup device using an invisible laser beam (1550 nm wavelength) projected onto surfaces such as glass, metal, paper or plastic to capture acoustic vibrations without direct contact. It enables recording or monitoring of conversations inside enclosed spaces such as meeting rooms or vehicles from a distance of up to several hundred meters. Surveillance is fully covert, leaves no trace, and is eye-safe thanks to the use of an appropriate laser wavelength.

products.name: Optical Microphone
products.desc: A high-sensitivity optical microphone specifically designed for covert long-range audio surveillance, operating effectively even in harsh environments. Constructed from plastic and glass with no electronic or metal components, the device offers optimal resistance to electromagnetic interference and minimizes the risk of detection.

products.name: Multi-Function Audio Transceiver
products.desc: A remote audio-surveillance device enabling high-quality in-room recording, with data stored directly to a memory card. The system operates independently using a rechargeable battery with low power consumption, suited to extended monitoring tasks.

products.name: Ultra-Thin Full HD Recording Device with Remote Control
products.desc: A device designed to capture high-quality Full HD video and store it directly to a memory card. The device applies AES-256 encryption to prevent unauthorized access to recorded files, includes a recording timer, and supports automatic recording activation via voice trigger. Recording can be started or stopped remotely, with settings and file management handled through dedicated software with a user-friendly interface.

products.name: Multi-Function Digital Audio/Video Transceiver
products.desc: A device designed to record video and transmit encrypted data over a wireless link using COFDM modulation, ensuring high-quality, stable image transmission under complex signal conditions such as motion, line-of-sight obstruction or interference. With an ultra-thin, compact design, the device is easy to integrate into various forms of concealment for missions requiring high covertness. It can record audio and video at the transmitter while streaming live imagery to the receiver with extremely low latency, and the transmitter can be remote-controlled from the receiver. Both stored and transmitted data are secured using AES-256 encryption.

products.name: Covert Wall-Drilling System
products.desc: An ultra-low-noise wall-drilling system specifically designed for tasks requiring discretion, enabling small holes to be drilled without drawing attention. The device drills effectively into a variety of materials such as concrete, cement and brick, and is suited to surveillance, reconnaissance and special technical operations.

products.name: Dedicated Keyhole Scanning System
products.desc: A keyhole-scanning system using ultrasound technology designed to decode most current mechanical locks. Using ultrasound technology, the system scans and reconstructs the internal mechanism of a lock in detail without disassembly, helping the user produce a corresponding duplicate key.

products.name: Vehicle-Mounted 2G/3G/4G/5G Mobile Subscriber Detection & Locating System
products.desc: Used to collect the identifiers (IMSI) of 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G mobile subscribers within a range of up to 250 m, as well as to precisely determine their location. Uses advanced SDR technology, enabling operation with all 2G/3G/4G/5G standards of every mobile network operator in Vietnam. The BTS transmit power can be flexibly adjusted according to mission requirements. The system can check for a target's presence, and direction-find and search for a subscriber of interest via a handheld locator. Communication-parameter setup is automatically optimized to maximize the number of subscribers captured, while using an LAC matching that of the genuine network operator to avoid detection.

products.name: Body-Worn 2G/3G/4G/5G Mobile Subscriber Locating System
products.desc: Used to collect the identifiers (IMSI) of 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G mobile subscribers within a range of up to 50 m, as well as to precisely determine their location. Uses advanced SDR technology, enabling operation with all 2G/3G/4G/5G standards of every mobile network operator in Vietnam. Its low transmit power and light weight make it suitable for use in high-rise buildings and narrow alleys inaccessible to a vehicle.

products.name: Mobile Subscriber Geolocation System
products.desc: Used to geolocate, determine the position of, and track 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G mobile subscribers by connecting to the mobile network operator's signaling system. The device supports monitoring of domestic subscribers, international subscribers roaming into Vietnam, and domestic subscribers traveling abroad. Input data is an IMSI or MSISDN number; the returned results include the subscriber's precise position and coordinates presented in visual, graphical form.

products.name: Call-Record Link Analysis & Association-Chart System
products.desc: A system designed to support analysis of data gathered during an investigation and search, helping the operator gain a clear, comprehensive picture of the relationships between the parties involved. Input data includes Call Detail Records (CDR) and Internet Protocol Detail Records (IPDR). Through visual analysis tools, the system presents results as connection diagrams, timelines and other graphical formats.

products.name: Audio Recording, Collection & Analysis System
products.desc: A system used to collect, record, store and manage audio data from a variety of signal sources such as microphones, telephone lines and similar audio sources. The device supports simultaneous multi-channel recording, real-time signal-activity monitoring, long-term data storage, and provides tools for searching, playback, tagging, categorization and data management through a secure web interface. The system meets the requirements for voice recognition, speaker identification and other in-depth audio analysis tasks.

products.name: Drone Suppression Gun
products.desc: Designed to detect, direction-find and suppress drones by jamming their control, data-link and satellite-positioning signals. Capable of standalone operation, suited to security and military forces for protecting sensitive areas, counter-surveillance, counter-terrorism and protection of major events.

products.name: UAV Detection & Suppression System
products.desc: A multi-function electronic-warfare system capable of detecting, direction-finding, locating and jamming the control links, data links and satellite-navigation systems (GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo) of UAVs. Supports multiple operating modes and can be deployed in a fixed installation or mounted on a military vehicle for mobile use, effectively serving security, defense, counter-terrorism and target-protection missions. Capable of spoofing positioning signals to force a UAV off course and cause it to land at a designated area; displays the position of the UAV and its ground control stations on a digital map; monitors and tracks a UAV at close range using an electro-optical module.

products.name: High-Power Long-Range Illuminator with Infrared Filter
products.desc: A mobile, multi-purpose illuminator designed for effective use in a range of operational situations such as long-range illumination, subject control, crowd dispersal, search-and-rescue operations and covert night searches. With long-range illumination capability and extended battery life, the device meets the demands of specialized and emergency operations.

products.name: Laser Dazzler for Subject Control
products.desc: A dedicated laser illumination device emitting red light that meets safety standards, causing no fatality or permanent eye injury. The device can produce temporary dazzling to reduce a subject's ability to resist within a range of several dozen meters, and also supports search and transmission of a warning signal.

products.name: Multi-Function Anti-Riot Shield
products.desc: A multi-function hand-held anti-riot shield is a dedicated device that supports law-enforcement forces in crowd-control situations or in subduing dangerous subjects. The shield integrates several utilities such as a pepper-spray canister, illumination light, alarm siren and door-breaching aid, improving operational effectiveness.

products.name: Baton
products.desc: A baton helps quickly prevent or subdue violent or resistant behavior without the need for lethal weapons.

products.name: Handcuffs
products.desc: Handcuffs secure the hands of a detained person, restricting their ability to resist, attack or flee.

products.name: Handheld 3D Laser Scanning System
products.desc: A dedicated 3D scanning system used to accurately create detailed 3D drawings of parts or products. With high mobility and flexibility, the system can be deployed in confined spaces. It supports scanning objects from small to large without size restriction, and effectively handles complex surfaces such as stainless steel or glossy black finishes without the need for scanning spray, even while the scanner and the object are both in motion.

products.name: Metal 3D Printing System
products.desc: A high-power 3D printing system with a compact, precise design, suited to a range of applications from rapid prototyping and low-volume production to mass production and in-depth research. The device supports printing with a diverse range of materials such as steel, titanium, nickel, copper and aluminum, flexibly meeting technical requirements across industrial and technology sectors.

products.name: FDM Plastic 3D Printing System
products.desc: An optimal solution combining high print quality with the ability to produce large-sized parts. The system supports printing a variety of materials, enabling the creation of complex parts with high precision. Setup is simple and easy to operate without extensive training, suited to a wide range of applications.

products.name: 6K-Resolution 3D Stereo Microscope
products.desc: The world's first digital 3D stereo microscope equipped with a 6K-resolution camera and a wide field of view, delivering accurate stereoscopic image reproduction that effectively supports examiners in analyzing, measuring specimens and identifying forged traces such as seals or questioned documents. The device integrates a range of lighting systems, flexibly meeting different observation conditions. With multiple observation and imaging modes, this microscope is widely used across many scientific and technical fields. The system can also export reports directly in common formats such as Excel, Word and PDF.

products.name: 3D Crime-Scene Scanning & Reconstruction System
products.desc: A system that captures three-dimensional imagery of a scene objectively and accurately, enabling full reconstruction of the context in which an event occurred. The captured 3D data helps authorities analyze and assess the scene after the on-site examination without needing to return to the physical location. Notably, the system can faithfully preserve "hot" traces that are prone to change due to weather conditions or that self-degrade over time.

products.name: Digital Forensic Data Recovery & Extraction Lab System
products.desc: A dedicated digital/electronic forensic data-recovery and extraction laboratory system, fully integrating the hardware, tools and dedicated software needed to give maximum support to specialists in data collection and recovery. The system can efficiently process data from a wide range of digital media, including HDD/SSD drives, mobile phones, Flash memory cards, NAND storage devices and DVR/CCTV recorders. With the ability to recover data in complex scenarios, including from damaged devices, this laboratory system is an indispensable tool for digital investigation, electronic forensic examination and in-depth digital-data analysis.

products.name: Automated SMT Electronic Board Assembly Line
products.desc: An automated SMT (surface-mount technology) electronic board assembly line, designed as a modern, synchronized production line, meeting the requirements for high-precision electronic component manufacturing. The line includes a full set of modern equipment such as a solder-paste printer, a Solder Paste Inspection (SPI) machine, a component placement machine, a reflow oven and an oven-temperature measurement device. After soldering, boards are inspected by an automated AOI machine. The entire process is supported by a board-feeding/unloading system and conveyor, ensuring fast, precise production, reduced defects and increased throughput.

products.name: Security Camera Surveillance System
products.desc: A security camera surveillance system is a modern technology solution widely used to ensure the safety of an area requiring protection. The system comprises observation cameras installed at key locations, combined with recording devices and management software, enabling real-time monitoring, recording and storage of images and video. With the ability to operate continuously 24/7 and support remote monitoring over the internet, the camera system helps detect intrusion, theft or unusual incidents early, contributing to more effective management, prevention and timely handling of security situations.

products.name: Wireless Intrusion Detection System
products.desc: An automated, standalone surveillance solution using sensors such as seismic, infrared and microwave sensors to detect intruding subjects. The system integrates with fixed cameras and UAVs to track and verify a target accurately and promptly. Its flexible architecture suits a variety of terrain types, with all sensor information sent to a command center for comprehensive monitoring of the surveillance area.

products.name: Simulated Training Range
products.desc: A modern tactical training solution applying XR technology (VR, AR, MR) to create an ultra-realistic virtual battlefield environment. The system lets personnel practice combat skills and improve decision-making and team coordination under high-pressure situations. With diverse simulated scenarios such as urban settings, narrow alleys, buildings and shopping centers, trainees can train under realistic conditions without using live ammunition, reducing risk. Simulated weapons replicate real weight, recoil and handling, helping build muscle memory.

products.name: Tank Driving & Gunnery Simulator System
products.desc: A simulator system designed to meet the teaching and integrated training requirements of a tank crew, serving combined-arms coordination in gunnery, driving and tactical deployment tasks on varied terrain and operating conditions.

products.name: Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) Reconnaissance System
products.desc: An OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) system is a tool for collecting, processing and analyzing data from public sources to support intelligence, surveillance and decision-making. An OSINT system is a critical platform for cyberspace monitoring, national security and social stability. Key functions: collecting data from social media, press, websites, forums, public databases and the dark web; filtering and normalizing data, removing noise, duplicate or irrelevant data; content analysis using NLP/AI to identify topics, entities, sentiment and relationships; real-time monitoring; early warning of terrorism, cybercrime and disinformation risks; data visualization; and export of intelligence reports.

products.name: UAV-Based Satellite Uplink Monitoring System
products.desc: A satellite-monitoring system using an unmanned aerial platform to detect, locate and track the activity of ground satellite-transmission stations. The device collects radio-frequency data and telemetry signals, operating in a passive or semi-active mode. The system integrates an optical-thermal camera for simultaneous real-world imaging. Data is processed to produce a 4D heat map, supporting spectrum monitoring and tactical analysis.
